JSON_value:
Functional connectivity (FC) in resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI) is widely used to
find coactivating regions in the human brain. Despite its widespread use, the effects of sex and age on resting FC
are not well characterized, especially during early adulthood.
